## Fix pushed: Gerrit change 2662 (not submitted, not closed)

### AC1 — the design decision: a set-but-empty boolean is a FAULT (raises), not "unset"

`_as_bool` now rejects an empty/whitespace-only string. `""` was removed from `_FALSE`,
with a dedicated error naming the `${VAR}`-expanded-to-nothing shape and the accepted
vocabulary (a bare `got ''` reads as a mystery).

Justified against ruling `39f8-ae7c` — *"a fault must error, never silently resolve to a
default, even a safe one"*:

1. **"Treat as unset" is precisely what the ruling forbids.** It is a silent resolution
   to a default. The ruling anticipates the "but the default is safe" defence and
   rejects it.
2. **"Treat as unset" is not even safe here.** It is safe only for the protection-
   direction keys. On the CAPABILITY gates, where the file says `true`, unset-semantics
   would let the file through and turn the capability ON where today it is withheld —
   a NEW silent weakening in the opposite direction, the same trap as adding `""` to
   `_TRUE`.
3. **Raising is the only direction-neutral answer.** It moves no gate either way, on any
   of the 27 boolean keys.
4. **It is loud and diagnosable.** The empty string was the sole silent input on a gate
   documented as fail-loud; it now behaves like every other malformed value.

### AC2 — the class, with dispositions. Fixed at the coercion seam, so ALL 27 are covered

**Protection-direction (`False` = a control is OFF). Silently weakened before; now raise:**
`mcp.readonly`, `mcp.auth_enabled`, `identity.require_authenticated`,
`verify.require_plan_review_for_claim`, `verify.require_plan_review_for_close`,
`verify.require_completion_verification_for_close`, `verify.require_ticket_for_commit`,
`verify.enforce_plan_material_pins`, `verify.enable_code_review`,
`verify.completion_floor_active`, `verify.contradiction_xcheck_active`,
`verify.comment_trail_xcheck_active`, plus the two default-`True` keys an empty value
flipped OFF: `warnings.cross_session`, `ensure.hint_enabled`.

**Capability-direction (`False` = a capability is WITHHELD). Was safe by luck of
direction, still silent; now raise — and explicitly NOT re-read as "unset", which would
have granted them:** `mcp.allow_llm`, `mcp.allow_jira_sync`.

**Permission-direction (`False` = the unsafe thing is DISALLOWED). Safe direction; now
raise for uniformity:** `mcp.allow_unauthenticated_http`,
`mcp.auth_jwt_allow_private_jwks_host`, `mcp.auth_introspection_allow_private_host`,
`mcp.auth_introspection_allow_missing_aud`, `reconciler.id_guard_bypass_unsafe`,
`reconciler.allow_insecure`, `jira.allow_insecure`, `mcp.http_tls_at_edge`.

**Neutral/display:** `ui.enabled`, `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets`,
`verify.completion_pinned_ticket_view`.

### AC3 — "unset means denied" verified, not assumed

`_config_sources.env_overrides` still gates on key PRESENCE, so a genuinely-absent
variable contributes no env layer at all and the built-in `False` default still denies.
Asserted directly against a config file that is SILENT on the key
(`test_capability_gate_denies_when_absent_from_both_env_and_file`), not merely reasoned
about.

### AC4 — regression test, RED-first against unmodified main

`tests/unit/test_config_empty_env_bool_b2ff.py` (46 tests) drives the REAL resolvers
(`config.mcp_readonly`, `config.mcp_gate`, `load_config`) against a real on-disk
`rebar.toml` that sets the OPPOSITE of each expectation. Matrix: `""`, `"  "`, `"\t"`,
`"\n"`, unset, `garbage`, and explicit `false`/`0`/`off`/`true`/`1`/`ON`.

Run against the unmodified tree it was **16 failed / 30 passed** — every failure
`DID NOT RAISE ConfigError` on an empty-string path, and the 30 control assertions
(unset honours the file, explicit values override, malformed raises, capability denied
by default) passing on healthy `main`. With the fix: 46/46.

### AC5 — one pass over ALL config keys, filed separately

Post-fix, 67 of 104 keys raise on `""`. 37 still accept it. Verified at the CONSUMER
that `mcp.http_allowed_hosts`/`http_allowed_origins` (McpStartupError) and
`mcp.auth_jwt_algorithms` (AuthConfigError) already fail closed. Five keys carry real
residue — `verify.require_environment`, `verify.opcert_enforce_since`,
`identity.enforce_since`, `mcp.auth_required_scopes`, `mcp.auth_jwt_expected_typ` —
where an env `""` still defeats a file-set control. That needs a DIFFERENT fix (for
these, `""` is the documented "off" spelling and equals the default, so a blanket raise
would break normal configuration), so it is filed as `imperfect-sombre-blackfish`
(`ee17-de97-09bf-4df4`), linked `discovered_from`, with the full enumeration attached.

### Gates

`make lint` clean; complexity ratchet `new=0 increased=0`; mechanism ratchet
`new=0 increased=0` (the one new autouse fixture was REMOVED rather than justified —
it is now an explicitly-requested fixture); `make typecheck` clean (763 files).
1,124 tests run green across the config/MCP/docs-parity surface.

**Note on an unrelated environmental failure:** `tests/unit/workflow/
test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py` fails with `GateCongestedError: all 4 concurrent
gate slots on this host are in use`. Confirmed environmental, not this change: pristine
`origin/main` in the same worktree fails identically. Sibling agents' gate runs are
holding the host's admission slots. No action taken.

No `--force` or gate bypass was used anywhere. Change 2662 is NOT submitted and this
ticket is NOT closed.
